name: Buffer Overflow Benchmark
description: Software model checking based on abstraction-refinement has recently achieved widespread success in verifying API conformance in device drivers, and we believe this success can be replicated for the problem of buffer overflow detection. This paper presents a publicly-available benchmark suite to help guide and evaluate this research. The benchmark consists of 298 code fragments of varying complexity capturing 22 buffer overflow vulnerabilities in 12 open source applications. We give a preliminary evaluation of the benchmark using the SatAbs model checker
notes: Small (298 code fragments) non-LLM benchmark focused on static analysis/model checking for buffer overflows. Limited size, not saturated by modern LLMs; potential contamination if code fragments appear in large code corpora; primarily used in formal verification research rather than end-to-end LLM evaluation.
